outcome: Anxiety levels (measured using the STAI-State/Trait scale)
cohort: 64 women receiving elective Cesarean delivery in Spain (31 with partner accompaniment and 33 without)
finding: Women who were accompanied by their partners during elective Cesarean delivery had significantly lower anxiety levels compared to those who were not accompanied.
mod_finding: This study found that women who were accompanied by their partners during elective cesarean deliveries experienced lower levels of anxiety compared to women who were not accompanied.
